feature: A box over zooms and keys keeps them all picked
summary: A box that touches a recording's zoom and its keys, with no clip in it, now keeps all of them picked: the panel says how many, Delete takes them all as one step, and pulling the zoom bar or any of the keys carries the rest with it.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Open the sample recording, key its Scale at 0:01 and 0:03, and add a zoom at 0:02.

try.do: Drag a box along the recording's Zoom lane across the zoom bar.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Hold Shift and drag a second box along the Scale lane across both keys: the panel reads 3 picked, 1 zoom, 2 keys.
Press Delete: the zoom and both keys go. Press Cmd Z once: all three come back.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Pick them again and drag the zoom bar half a second later: both keys go with it and stay picked.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Cmd Z, pick them again and drag one of the keys instead: the zoom and the other key follow.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

evaluate: Does the pick look like one thing when the zoom bar and the keys light together with no clip lit?
Does dragging by a key feel the same as dragging by the zoom bar?
When one of them meets the end of the recording, does the whole group stopping there feel right, rather than leaving that one behind?
Is 3 picked, 1 zoom, 2 keys enough in the panel, or do you want the zoom's own settings there as well?
rough: No mock covers a box pick of zooms and keys alone; this follows the box pick already shipped beside clips.
Holding Option while dragging such a pick moves it rather than copying it. A copy is made only when a clip is in the pick.
A box that touches only keys on several layers now keeps them all as well, where it used to keep only the layer with the most keys.
